result.card: This pull request makes common::WriteSettings write to a temporary file and atomically replace the target destination with RenameOver. Previously, banlist.json was written directly in place, leaving node operators vulnerable to a truncated or corrupted banlist if the write was interrupted by a crash or power failure. It also removes duplicate temporary-file management logic in ArgsManager::WriteSettingsFile and adds unit tests covering atomic banlist writes and rename failure handling.
